answer.thought: The air quality index of 149 is an insult to the lungs, a hazy smudge that turns the bright white of my kurta into a dull grey. I have walked enough for the morning; the body requires rest before the mind can properly contemplate the dialectic of the spirit. I shall sit in the shade of the veranda and let the heat press down, observing the stillness of the compound.
